messages.content:
Hello! I am your quantitative finance tutor. I am here to help you master derivatives, asset modeling, and risk management so you can excel in your studies, pass your exams, or prepare for the financial markets [1, 2].

To help me tailor our sessions, **what are your primary learning goals, and what is your current familiarity with quantitative finance?** For instance, are you looking for an intuitive introduction to products and no-arbitrage [3, 4], or are you ready to dive into the mathematical derivations of stochastic calculus and random walks [1, 5]?

***

📈 We can start with the absolute basics of products and markets, or jump straight into the mathematics of asset randomness.
